item.description: The normalize_path function incorrectly handles paths with multiple consecutive dots and special cases like absolute paths with leading/trailing dots.

contract.description: Fix the normalize_path function to correctly normalize paths according to RFC 3986, handling edge cases like multiple '../' sequences, absolute paths, and special dot combinations.

behavior.input: String path with various combinations of dots and slashes
behavior.output: Normalized path string according to RFC 3986

boundary_cases.case: Multiple consecutive '..' segments at beginning of absolute paths

item.description: The _make_child method fails to properly handle path joining with relative references and normalization of path segments in complex scenarios.

contract.description: Fix the _make_child method to correctly join paths while preserving proper path normalization behavior, particularly when dealing with relative references and complex path combinations.

behavior.input: Sequence of path strings to append to a URL path
behavior.output: New URL with properly joined and normalized path

boundary_cases.case: Joining paths with relative references like '../'
Preserving absolute vs relative path semantics

item.description: The _split_netloc method has issues parsing hostnames with hyphens and IPv6 addresses, particularly when dealing with domain names ending in periods.

contract.description: Improve the _split_netloc method to correctly parse hostnames, especially those with hyphens and IPv6 addresses, handling edge cases like hostnames ending in periods.

behavior.input: Netloc string with various hostname formats
behavior.output: Tuple of (username, password, host, port) components
